mstts:express-as.prosody:
As we wrap up, just take a moment to think about what this journey really means.
If you've been following along, you’ve seen how someone’s world can change in a heartbeat—and how, with time, love, and a little faith, it’s possible to build something beautiful again, sometimes in a way you never imagined. The story of the girl who lost her arm to a shark, and still found her way back to the waves, isn’t just about surfing, or even survival.
It’s really about those quiet, everyday acts of courage that keep us going, and the way a community can lift us up when we feel like we just can’t do it on our own.
Here are a few gentle reminders you might want to carry with you on your own path:
Healing? It’s almost never a straight line. There will be setbacks, and that’s okay—they’re just part of the journey.
Reaching out for help doesn’t mean you’re weak—it actually shows real strength.
The people around you—your community, your connections—matter just as much as determination and grit.
Sometimes, when you lose something, new dreams can take root in the most surprising and beautiful ways.
And don’t forget—sharing your story, even when you feel it isn’t finished yet, can give someone else hope.
So, as you take your next steps, remember: resilience isn’t about never falling. It’s about finding the courage to get up again—maybe with help, maybe with faith, but always with hope.
The waves of life are going to come—some will be gentle, some will knock you off your feet. You might not get to choose what happens, but you do get to choose how you respond, and who you let walk beside you.
Let this story remind you—you're not alone. Whatever you’re facing, there’s a community out there ready to support you, and a future that’s still completely open, full of possibilities.
So take it one small step at a time, celebrate those little victories, and trust that with time, the tides will turn.
Your story, just like hers, is still being written—one wave, one day, one brave act at a time.
